headline: Another Auto Industry Giant Begins Harsh Downsizing: Several Hundred Workers Put Out on the Street, Most Jobs Cut in Production
summary: Japanese company Fujikura is laying off more than 300 employees at its Dej plant in Romania, which makes automotive components. The figures come from the Cluj County Employment Agency, as reported by actualdecluj.ro.
why: Fujikura is a Japanese maker of electronic wire and automotive components, and plant cutbacks in Europe reflect pressure on auto suppliers.
